description: The Enterprise crew faces increasingly personal tests involving duty, family and identity, from the Klingon civil war and Spock's Romulan mission to Borg ethics and Picard's extraordinary remembered lifetime.

s05e01.description: Picard exposes Romulan support behind the Klingon civil war while Worf fights beside Gowron to restore his family’s honor.

s05e02.description: Picard is stranded with a Tamarian captain whose language is built entirely from cultural metaphor, forcing communication through shared danger.

s05e03.description: A disgraced Bajoran officer joins the Enterprise to investigate attacks that may conceal a Starfleet-backed political scheme.

s05e04.description: The Enterprise investigates the Crystalline Entity with a scientist whose desire for revenge threatens Picard’s attempt at peaceful contact.

s05e05.description: A quantum filament cripples the Enterprise, isolating the crew into small groups while Troi unexpectedly faces command decisions on the bridge.

s05e06.description: Riker brings an addictive neural game aboard that begins controlling the crew, leaving Wesley and a young ensign to resist its spread.

s05e07.description: Picard and Data secretly enter Romulan territory after evidence suggests Ambassador Spock has defected from the Federation.

s05e08.description: Picard discovers Spock’s underground effort to reunify Vulcans and Romulans while Sela turns the movement into an invasion scheme.

s05e09.description: A historian claiming to come from the future visits the Enterprise during a planetary disaster and refuses to reveal what happens next.

s05e10.description: Worf’s son Alexander comes to live aboard the Enterprise just as an experimental propulsion project threatens a nearby world.

s05e11.description: Data bonds with the sole child survivor of a destroyed starship, who begins imitating the android to cope with trauma.

s05e12.description: Telepathic visitors probe buried memories among the crew, leaving victims comatose while Troi confronts a violation disguised as diplomacy.

s05e13.description: The Enterprise rescues a genetically engineered colony whose carefully designed social order begins unraveling after contact with outsiders.

s05e14.description: The crew loses all personal memory but retains professional skills, then receives orders suggesting the Enterprise is fighting a war.

s05e15.description: Alien entities possess Troi, Data and O’Brien and seize control of the ship while claiming to be survivors of an old disaster.

s05e16.description: Worf is paralyzed in an accident and considers ritual suicide while competing medical approaches clash over an experimental treatment.

s05e17.description: Riker becomes close to a member of an androgynous species who secretly identifies as female and faces compulsory psychological correction.

s05e18.description: The Enterprise is trapped in a repeating time loop ending in destruction, with only fragments of memory surviving each reset.

s05e19.description: Wesley’s Starfleet Academy squadron is investigated after a fatal flight accident, forcing him to choose between loyalty and truth.

s05e20.description: Lwaxana prepares for an arranged marriage while Alexander struggles with discipline and strange parasites consume the Enterprise from within.

s05e21.description: Picard transports a woman genetically conditioned to bond with another leader, creating an ethical conflict when she instead connects with him.

s05e22.description: A child’s imaginary companion becomes physically real and begins judging the Enterprise crew through the girl’s eyes.

s05e23.description: The crew rescues an injured Borg drone and Picard must decide whether to use him as a weapon capable of destroying the Collective.

s05e24.description: Geordi and Ro are presumed dead but remain aboard the Enterprise in a phased state, invisible and unable to interact with the crew.

s05e25.description: An alien probe makes Picard experience decades as a man on a dying world, leaving him with an entire lifetime of memories.

s05e26.description: Data is thrown into 19th-century San Francisco after the crew discovers evidence that aliens are feeding on humans across time.
